_comment: Each document page shows one thing: the final file. Download button, an inline preview, and an "Open in new tab" link.
title: Curriculum Vitae
description: Education, activities, and achievements on one page.
summary: A one-page CV aimed at marketing internships. It leads with my degree and the activities where I actually did marketing work, then condenses my academic awards, so an employer reads what I can do before they read what I have won.

title: Cover Letter
description: An introduction for the marketing roles I am applying to.
summary: A cover letter for a Marketing Specialist role, connecting the marketing and content work I did in high school clubs to what that kind of position actually needs.

title: LinkedIn Profile
description: My professional profile, the version an employer finds first.
summary: A snapshot of my LinkedIn profile, included because it is the version of my professional self that an employer is most likely to find first — and the one that has to work without me in the room.
